property_summary: For any fuzzed bytes4 probe q, supportsInterface(q merged with the IAccessControl interface id, i.e. (q | type(IAccessControl).interfaceId) == type(IAccessControl).interfaceId) must report support; more concretely, for every fuzzed id the contract must return true whenever the queried id equals the IAccessControl interface id derived on-chain, and the mutant that checks IERC165's id instead returns false for that query.
change_summary: Replace the IAccessControl interface id check with a check for the IERC165 interface id, so IAccessControl is no longer advertised as supported.
